title: Linux Administration: Users, Groups & Access
purpose: Eight connected offline guest exercises: account metadata, lifecycle, group refresh, ownership, setgid, umask, account restrictions and an access-repair handover. Sequence is guidance, not a forced unlock.
prerequisites: Bash quoting, paths and mode bits; approved administrator image prepared separately. Read sudo commands before typing; no credentials, learner-account edits or host administration.
coverage: LPIC-1 objectives v5.0: partial 107.1 and 104.5; integration reinforces earlier file skills. LPIC-2 v4.5 210.2 remains a gap: no PAM/SSSD configuration or remote authentication. Self-reviewed completion, no verification score.

entries.description: Separate account database information from a running process's identity.
troubleshooting: If sudo is missing or the image is unavailable, stop: do not substitute the unprivileged image or install packages.
A permission error is evidence. Test as the intended user, not root. Inspect every parent directory and current process groups.

cleanup: First inspect: pgrep -u ll-u1 -a. If any processes remain, stop only your exact tracked practice process before cleanup. Then sudo userdel -r ll-u1. This removes this disposable home/mail only; never run it on learner.
Confirm ! getent passwd ll-u1; ! getent group ll-u1; test ! -e /home/ll-u1. A private group is normally removed when unused; inspect unexpected leftovers rather than deleting another account's group.
